8-day event (15–23 March and 15–23 September) + 7 days of rewards

Twice-yearly world event: three sorcerers, Furb of Fun (orange), Feiz of Power (violet) and Fern of Nature (green), compete to see who has the most followers. You collect coloured powders from envelopes dropped by monsters, mark yourself with a colour and combine the rest of the powder with another player of a different colour to join a sorcerer. The winner gives the whole server a week-long bonus and you earn points to trade for {item:Zaoan Chess Piece|Zaoan Chess Pieces}.

A contest between three wizards has spread across Tibia, and now mysterious letters with coloured powders are found everywhere. Choose your wizard and convince your friends to join your cause: what is your true colour?

Use the rest of the powder on another player

Find another player marked with a **different colour** and use the rest of your powder on them (or let them use theirs on you). When you use a whole powder on yourself and the rest on another player, you join the wizard of the combined colour and earn the **I Did My Part** achievement (if you did not have it yet).
I Did My Part achievement + 10 bonus points
You can only mark another player if:
They have already used a powder on themselves.
They are not the same colour as you.
They have not joined any wizard yet (so two people cannot be each other's "partners": a chain in a larger group is needed).
Follow this example to understand the chain:
Player **A** uses the red powder and becomes **red**.
Player **B** uses the yellow powder and becomes **yellow**.
**A** uses the rest of the powder on **B**, who becomes **orange**. **A** joins the orange wizard (+1 point for Furb of Fun) and cannot join any other.
**B**, now orange, can no longer be marked by other players.
**B** also cannot use their powder on **A**: they have to find another player who is blue (joins green) or red (joins orange). Never someone orange, violet or green.

To give the maximum votes to, say, orange: one character uses a yellow powder **without marking anyone**. All the other characters in the world can then use a red powder and mark that same yellow player: each marking counts as a vote for orange. As long as the yellow player does not mark anyone, there is no limit to how many players can mark them.

With a friend, do the same at the same time with two characters (one yellow and one red), to make use of both red and yellow powders. Stand somewhere busy, like the Thais depot, and announce that you are available.
4. Bonus points and Zaoan Chess Pieces
You can earn at most **30 bonus points** per character per event:
Handing in 5 powders in favour of your wizard to his representative (say {key:exchange}); you can only do this 10 times
Get the box and exchange the points
Talk to the representative of the wizard you chose. He gives you a free {item:Zaoan Chess Box} (only one per event) and lets you spend your points on {item:Zaoan Chess Piece|Zaoan Chess Pieces}:
A random piece (the queen is rare)
A piece of your choice (except the queens)
